title: 2023 Comparison: Purnia vs Nalanda
question: Download the 2023 comparison table for Purnia and Nalanda showing training completion and 6-month employment rates.

view.title: 2023 Comparison: Purnia vs Nalanda
view.note: This table shows the 2023 figures for Purnia and Nalanda. Completion rate is the number of women who completed training divided by those enrolled. Employment rate is the number employed at 6 months divided by those enrolled. Both are expressed as percentages. The insights above state the 2023 gap in percentage points. This file alone cannot explain why one district performs differently from another, so no intervention can be recommended without guessing.

insight_specs.message: This file contains only aggregate counts (enrolled, completed, employed) by district and year. It has no information about programme design, funding, staffing, infrastructure, participant characteristics, or any other factor that could explain why one district outperforms another. No causal explanation or specific intervention recommendation can be drawn from this data alone.

insights.label: What this data cannot answer
insights.text: This file shows differences and changes, but it has no explanatory variables and cannot establish why they occurred.
